title: Upper-Body Interval Strength Circuit
description: A short, timed circuit of chair-based upper-body exercises designed to build the pushing power and endurance wheelchair basketball specifically demands.

content.objective: Build the specific pushing power and upper-body endurance wheelchair basketball demands.
content.setup: Players space out with a stopwatch running the intervals; no equipment needed beyond the chair itself.
instructions: Perform 30 seconds of fast shadow-push arm cycles, then 15 seconds rest.
Perform 30 seconds of seated punches alternating arms, then 15 seconds rest.
Perform 30 seconds of trunk rotations holding a light medicine ball if available, then 15 seconds rest.
Repeat the full three-station circuit twice more.
coachingPoints: Keep the movement quality high even as fatigue builds.
Use the full available range of motion on every rep.
Breathe steadily rather than holding the breath through each station.
commonMistakes: Letting technique collapse for the sake of speed.
Skipping the short rest interval and risking poor form on the next station.
Pacing too conservatively instead of working at real effort.
content.safety: Stop any station immediately that causes sharp pain in the shoulders or wrists.
